result.summary: Round 1, lens market: wrote runs/WF06-20260925-01/assessment-market.json (sai.idea-assessment/1). I scored all 4 candidates on demand_evidence and competition_gap using 30 verbatim quotes, and read only run.json, sources/, quality-bar, WF-06, design §4 and my mandate. Scores (demand_evidence / competition_gap): 01-kviz-zayavki 4/2 (people pay for the same category, e.g. Marquiz and a Bitrix module in KZ, but the market is occupied and the differentiators are thin); 02-sai 3/4 (the problem is evidenced at industry level, the source itself says willingness to pay is unproven, the segment looks free but no competitor search is documented); 03-zhivoy-most 2/3 (the payer is unclear and the owner excludes the only known one; the niche is free but the neighbouring parts are free or taken); 04-kamery-kpp 3/2 (buyers pay for plates and faces, which are already solved and crowded; the 'what is in their hands' gap is narrow and partly covered by custom projects). Limitation: the project directory is named sai, the same as idea 02, so I know it was chosen earlier. I did not count this as evidence; it is stated in the 02 summary. Self-check: my own script matched all quotes against the cleaned copies ('checked 30 quotes, 0 problems'). All three assessment files existed at check time, so the full stage was validated: `npm run --silent validate -- ../runs/WF06-20260925-01 --stage assessments` -> 'OK WF06-20260925-01 (stage assessments)', exit=0.
